Name: Jotham, Son of Jahdai
Summary: Son of Jahdai, named in Judah's genealogy.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:47: Son of Jahdai, named in Judah's genealogy.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jotham stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
